keywords.name: if
keywords.description:
**if** - Conditional expression

Syntax: `if(condition) expr else expr`

If expressions always evaluate to a value. The `else` branch is required.

keywords.name: else
keywords.description:
**else** - Alternative branch in conditional statement

Used with `if` to provide the value when the condition is false.

keywords.name: elif
keywords.description:
**elif** - Additional conditional branch

Syntax: `elif(condition) expr`

Provides intermediate conditions between `if` and `else`.
keywords.syntax: if(cond1) expr1 elif(cond2) expr2 else expr3

keywords.name: mod
keywords.description:
**mod** - Module definition

Syntax: `mod name { ... }` or `mod { ... }` for anonymous modules

Defines a module containing related functions and variables.

keywords.name: use
keywords.description:
**use** - Import module or symbols

Syntax: `use(module_name)` or `use(module::symbol)`

Imports a module or specific symbols from a module.

keywords.name: this
keywords.description:
**this** - Reference to current module context

Syntax: `this::symbol`

Accesses module-level variables from within functions.

keywords.name: is
keywords.description:
**is** - Type checking operator

Syntax: `value is Type`

Checks if a value is of a specific type. Returns Bool.

types.name: Int
types.description:
**Int** - Integer number type

Represents whole numbers without fractional components.

types.name: Real
types.description:
**Real** - Real number type

Represents floating-point numbers with decimal precision.

types.name: Complex
types.description:
**Complex** - Complex number type

Represents numbers with real and imaginary components.

types.name: Bool
types.description:
**Bool** - Boolean type

Represents logical values: true or false.

types.name: String
types.description:
**String** - Text string type

Represents sequences of characters.

types.name: Vec
types.description:
**Vec** - Vector type

Represents eagerly-evaluated collections of values with indexed access.

types.name: Seq
types.description:
**Seq** - Sequence type

Represents lazy-evaluated collections for streaming operations.

types.name: Function
types.description:
**Function** - Function type

Represents callable procedures and expressions.

types.name: Module
types.description:
**Module** - Module type

Represents organizational units of code containing related definitions.

types.name: Any
types.description:
**Any** - Universal type

Top type that can represent any value. Used for generic operations.

types.name: Number
types.description:
**Number** - Generic number type

Union type covering Int, Real, and Complex. Used for numeric operations.

types.name: Type
types.description:
**Type** - Type of types

Meta-type representing type information. Returned by the `type()` function.

operators.description:
**:=** - Immutable variable declaration

Declares a variable that cannot be reassigned after initialization.

**;=** - Mutable variable declaration

Declares a variable that can be reassigned after initialization.

**=** - Assignment operator

Assigns a new value to a mutable variable. Cannot be used on immutable variables.

**+** - Addition operator

Adds two numbers or concatenates strings.

**-** - Subtraction or negation operator

Subtracts two numbers or negates a number.

***** - Multiplication operator

Multiplies two numbers.

**/** - Division operator

Divides two numbers.

**%** - Modulo operator

Returns the remainder of division.

**^** - Exponentiation operator

Raises a number to a power.

**==** - Equality operator

Checks if two values are equal.

**!=** - Inequality operator

Checks if two values are not equal.

**<** - Less than operator

Checks if left value is less than right value.

**<=** - Less than or equal operator

Checks if left value is less than or equal to right value.

**>** - Greater than operator

Checks if left value is greater than right value.

**>=** - Greater than or equal operator

Checks if left value is greater than or equal to right value.

**&** - Logical AND operator

Returns true if both operands are true.

**|** - Logical OR operator

Returns true if either operand is true.

**!** - Logical NOT operator

Negates a boolean value.

**->** - Pipeline operator

Passes the result of the left expression as the first argument to the right function.

**::** - Module access operator

Accesses members of a module.

**[]** - Index access operator

Accesses elements of a vector by index (0-based).

immutable.description: Declares an immutable variable that cannot be reassigned

mutable.description: Declares a mutable variable that can be reassigned

typed_immutable.description: Declares an immutable variable with explicit type

typed_mutable.description: Declares a mutable variable with explicit type
